mails.subject: Request: scheduling our next Orbit meeting
mails.body:
Dear Alex,

Thank you as always for your support.
This is Misaki Sato from Hoshizora Systems.

Regarding the Orbit proposal you shared with us the other day, we are moving forward with a positive internal review.
Could we set up a 30-minute online meeting to go over the quote details and the rollout schedule?

Would either of the following slots work for you?
- Today 15:00-15:30
- Tomorrow 10:00-10:30

I know you are busy, so I would appreciate it if you could reply with whichever time suits you best.
Thank you very much in advance.

Misaki Sato
Business Development, Hoshizora Systems

mails.subject: Partnership proposal: Q4 co-marketing campaign
mails.body:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for making time to meet with us last week. For the Q4 co-marketing campaign, we have put together a draft schedule and budget. The key points are below:

1. Campaign period: mid-November to the end of December
2. Main channels: pop-up stores in Taipei and Taichung, plus live-streamed events
3. Budget split: 50% each

If possible, could you let us know by this Friday whether you are interested in partnering? We will then schedule our next meeting.

Best regards,

Yijun Chen
Sales Department, Lumen
